2.3.19 Report.Description
The Report.Description element specifies the description of a Report. This element is optional. If this
element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1).
Following is the parent element of the Report.Description element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.Description element.
 <xsd:element name="Description" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
